name: Flow fault handler surfaces real RLM error (not 'unhandled fault')
expected: The Fortra_Order_Submission_Check screen flow (the 'Update Status' quick action) must have a faultConnector on EVERY record-update element so the real native RLM error ('PricingTermCount is required for Termed order products') surfaces via {!$Flow.FaultMessage} on the Error_Screen, instead of a generic 'unhandled fault'. Activating a termed line with null PTC via Update Status should therefore show a clear 'PricingTermCount required' message so the user can Reprice.
actual:
LIVE active flow = V16 (def 300WC00000PCNSHYA5, ver 301WC00000lTjmsYAC, status Active; SC-3411 fix shipped V14, survived V14->V16 churn). Retrieved live metadata has exactly 2 recordUpdates elements and 2 faultConnectors (1:1 coverage): Update_Order_Stage (the NOT-Order-Complete branch from Status_Route, the path the report flagged) -> faultConnector -> Error_Screen; and Set_Order_Status_Order_Complete -> faultConnector -> Error_Screen. Error_Screen field DisplayFaultMessage renders '

{!$Flow.FaultMessage}

'. Flow carries '2026-06-15: Add fault path so direct status-update errors surface instead of a generic flow fault'. Native error text confirmed real per SC-3411 RCA: 'PricingTermCount is required for Termed order products.' No current Draft order carries a TermDefined line with null PricingTermCount (0 rows) - the SC-3411 Set_Dates V6 self-heal backstop keeps the error class rare; the fault handler is the safety net for when the RLM check still fires.
